notes:
Company: mid-market personalization & discovery engine used by retailers. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API to iterate quickly and then Dedicated for predictable pricing and resident data. Team is pragmatic: want Hosted for initial 3-6 months, then shift core traffic to Dedicated.

Workload details / SLOs:
- Chat personalization: avg request length 120 tokens, typical sessions maintain ~3.5k token KV over conversation; p95 target 100-200ms for short gen (10-40 tokens).
- Embeddings: offline daily batch ~800k vectors + real-time enrichment ~2k reqs/min during peak.
- Reranking: lightweight reorders for top-20 candidates; target p95 < 60ms when using cached embeddings.

Cost sensitivity and economics:
- Finance target: break-even Dedicated within 4-6 months vs Hosted list pricing. Looking for >30% savings on steady state.
- Key metrics requested: per-1k-requests cost, per-1M-embeddings cost, cost delta by batch size and quant profile.

Summary of 2026-02-22 workshop outcomes:
- Batching: continuous batching simulation showed 2.3x token throughput improvement with batch caps at 24; larger batches yield diminishing returns and higher tail latency. Action: Priya to share perf matrix by 2026-03-04.
- Prefix/KV caching: for repeat personalization prompts, prefix cache hit expected 18-38% depending on session reuse; recommended LRU eviction tuned to session stickiness. Client to provide 1k anonymized sessions for production simulation (in progress).
- Quantization: evaluated q4_0 and q5_0 profiles on 500 prompt set; q4 stable for majority of personalization tasks but produced edge-case failures in SKU/entity fuzzy matches. Next step: 2k-prompt quant A/B and human eval for SKU matching. Ticket OPT-1588 created.
- Unit economics modeling: Redwood team produced Hosted vs Dedicated scenario table. For Asterion's baseline, Dedicated with 2 reserved nodes + autoscale saves ~33% at steady-state; Hosted preferable for unexpected spikes. Recommended hybrid routing (hosted for canary/burst, dedicated for steady).

Quotes:
- "We need a concrete per-1k-request number we can put in the Q2 budget doc. If Dedicated saves 30% and maintains quality, we move forward."  VP of Product (Rhea Kumar).

Risks / open items:
- Legal: DPA and US-only residency language under review; delays could push procurement past Q2.
- Quantization risk: SKU/entity regressions may impact core conversion metric; requires manual eval.
- Production validation: workshop used synthetic traffic; client requested small live canary to validate caching hit rates.

Immediate next steps:
- Redwood: provide batch-size -> p95 latency & cost tradeoff matrix (due 2026-03-04).
- Asterion: share 1k anonymized sessions and 2k evaluation prompts for quant A/B (in progress).
- Schedule Dedicated sizing + pricing review week of 2026-03-08.
